signals.usability_note: The frontage is almost entirely hidden behind dense evergreen trees and shrubs. Only a faint hint of a structure shows through the foliage, so the house cannot be assessed.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds and a dense row of evergreens line the curb, but nothing clearly shows crew-level maintenance.

signals.notes: The property is screened by dense evergreens and a large tree, so a field rep would need to view it in person to see the house or any signals.
